description_en: Queries the list of risk events under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下的风险事件列表
name: ListRiskItems

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页页码。取值范围：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The risk event ID. If specified, the exact risk event is queried
parameters.help_zh: 风险事件 ID。设置后，精确查询指定风险事件
parameters.name: risk_id

parameters.help_en:
The risk scenario. Valid values:
`account_share`: account sharing.
`account_stolen`: account theft.
`device_share`: device sharing.
`remote_logon`: remote logon from an unusual location.
`sensitive_data_leakage`: sensitive data exfiltration.
`compressed_archive_exfil`: compressed data exfiltration from the internal network.
`lateral_scanning`: lateral scanning.
`ai_skill_malware`: malicious Skill.
`ai_config_check`: AI configuration check.
`openclaw_vulnerability`: OpenClaw vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
风险场景。取值：
`account_share`：账号共享。
`account_stolen`：账号被盗。
`device_share`：设备共享。
`remote_logon`：异地登录。
`sensitive_data_leakage`：敏感数据外发。
`compressed_archive_exfil`：内网数据压缩外发。
`lateral_scanning`：横向扫描。
`ai_skill_malware`：恶意 Skill。
`ai_config_check`：AI 配置检查。
`openclaw_vulnerability`：OpenClaw 漏洞
parameters.name: risk_scene

parameters.help_en:
The risk category. Valid values:
`data_safe`: data security.
`identify_safe`: identity security.
`device_safe`: device security.
`access_safe`: access security.
`ai_agent_safe`: Agent security
parameters.help_zh:
风险类目。取值：
`data_safe`：数据安全。
`identify_safe`：身份安全。
`device_safe`：设备安全。
`access_safe`：访问安全。
`ai_agent_safe`：Agent 安全
parameters.name: risk_category

parameters.help_en:
The risk level. Valid values:
`High`: high risk.
`Medium`: medium risk.
`Low`: low risk
parameters.help_zh:
风险等级。取值：
`High`：高危。
`Medium`：中危。
`Low`：低危
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en: The disposition status of the risk event. This parameter cannot be set together with `StatusList`
parameters.help_zh: 风险事件处置状态。不能与 `StatusList` 同时设置
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The list of disposition statuses of risk events, in Flat serialization format. This parameter cannot be set together with Status
parameters.help_zh: 风险事件处置状态列表，使用 Flat 序列化格式。不能与 Status 同时设置
parameters.name: status_list

parameters.example: 异地登录风险分析策略
parameters.help_en: The name of the risk analysis policy. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 风险分析策略名称，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en: The username associated with the risk event. Fuzzy match is supported. Maximum length: 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 风险关联的用户名，支持模糊匹配。长度不超过 128 个字符
parameters.name: username

AgentName.description_en: The name of the Agent that generated the risk event. An empty string is returned for non-Agent risk scenarios
AgentName.description_zh: 产生该风险事件的 Agent 名称。非 Agent 风险场景时返回空字符串

AiConclusion.example: 该账号在非常用设备登录，行为与历史基线不一致。

AiRiskConfirm.description_en:
The risk judgment provided by AI. An empty string is returned if no AI analysis results exist. Valid values:
`Risk`: determined as risky.
`Ignore`: determined as not risky
AiRiskConfirm.description_zh:
AI 给出的风险判断。不存在 AI 分析结果时返回空字符串。取值：
`Risk`：判断为有风险。
`Ignore`：判断为无风险

CheckName.description_en: The name of the risk detection item

Department.description_en: The department to which the user associated with the risk event belongs
Department.description_zh: 风险关联用户所属部门

GroupInfo.description_en: The original organizational structure information of the user associated with the risk event
GroupInfo.description_zh: 风险关联用户的原始组织架构信息

Hostname.description_en: The name of the endpoint device associated with the risk event
Hostname.description_zh: 风险关联的终端设备名称

InnerIp.description_en: The internal IP address of the endpoint associated with the risk event
InnerIp.description_zh: 风险关联终端的内网 IP 地址

Report.description_en: The risk detection report or risk evidence
Report.description_zh: 风险检测报告或风险依据
Report.example: 检测到账号从新设备登录，且登录地点与常用地点不一致。

RiskAnalysisPolicyNames.description_en: The list of risk analysis policy names that were hit
RiskAnalysisPolicyNames.description_zh: 命中的风险分析策略名称列表

items.example: 异地登录风险分析策略

RiskCategory.description_en:
The risk category. Valid values:
`data_safe`: data security.
`identify_safe`: identity security.
`device_safe`: device security.
`access_safe`: access security.
`ai_agent_safe`: Agent security
RiskCategory.description_zh:
风险类目。取值：
`data_safe`：数据安全。
`identify_safe`：身份安全。
`device_safe`：设备安全。
`access_safe`：访问安全。
`ai_agent_safe`：Agent 安全

RiskConfirm.description_en:
The manually confirmed risk conclusion. An empty string is returned if not confirmed. Valid values:
`Risk`: confirmed as risky.
`Ignore`: confirmed as not risky.
`Invalid`: confirmed as a false positive
RiskConfirm.description_zh:
人工确认的风险结论。未确认时返回空字符串。取值：
`Risk`：确认为有风险。
`Ignore`：确认为无风险。
`Invalid`：确认为误报

RiskConfirmDesc.description_en: The description of the risk event disposition
RiskConfirmDesc.example: 经核查，该登录行为未经用户授权。

RiskDesc.example: 检测到账号在非常用设备上登录。

RiskEndTime.description_en: The end time of the risky behavior, in the format of `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
RiskEndTime.description_zh: 风险行为结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

RiskFeatureIds.description_en: The list of detection feature or detection item identifiers that triggered the risk event. A risk event may hit multiple identifiers. The specific values vary based on the risk scenario and detection rules
RiskFeatureIds.description_zh: 触发该风险事件的检测特征或检测项标识列表。一个风险事件可能命中多个标识，具体取值随风险场景和检测规则变化

items.description_en: The detection feature or detection item identifier. For example, unusual_location indicates that the logon location is inconsistent with the historical locations of the user
items.description_zh: 检测特征或检测项标识。例如，unusual_location 表示登录地点与用户历史常用地点不一致

RiskFoundTime.description_en: The time when the risk was detected, in the format of `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
RiskFoundTime.description_zh: 风险发现时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level. Valid values:
`High`: high risk.
`Medium`: medium risk.
`Low`: low risk
RiskLevel.description_zh:
风险等级。取值：
`High`：高危。
`Medium`：中危。
`Low`：低危

RiskStartTime.description_en: The start time of the risky behavior, in the format of `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`
RiskStartTime.description_zh: 风险行为开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`

SaseUserId.description_en: The SASE user ID associated with the risk event
SaseUserId.description_zh: 风险关联的 SASE 用户 ID

SkillName.description_en: The name of the Agent Skill that generated the risk event. An empty string is returned for non-Agent risk scenarios
SkillName.description_zh: 产生该风险事件的 Agent Skill 名称。非 Agent 风险场景时返回空字符串

Solution.description_en: The recommended remediation action for the risk event
Solution.example: 请核实账号使用人，并根据核查结果冻结账号或重置凭据。

Status.description_en:
The disposition status of the risk event. Valid values:
`Unprocess`: unprocessed.
`Processing`: being processed.
`Processed`: processed
Status.description_zh:
风险事件处置状态。取值：
`Unprocess`：未处理。
`Processing`：处理中。
`Processed`：已处理

SupportAnalysis.description_en:
Indicates whether AI risk analysis results exist. Valid values:
`true`: AI risk analysis results exist.
`false`: AI risk analysis results do not exist
SupportAnalysis.description_zh:
是否存在 AI 风险分析结果。取值：
`true`：存在。
`false`：不存在

Username.description_en: The username associated with the risk event

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of risk events that meet the query conditions
TotalNum.description_zh: 符合查询条件的风险事件总数
